title: 第2章 西边捡来的项西(2)
slug: 格格不入全本免费-格格不入最新章节列表
content_zh:
这样看起来比较惨，馒头说过，被逮着了事主没准一心软就算了。
“都不知道。”项西不是太想说话，一是张嘴就灌风，二是两天没进账，今儿晚上要还是没弄着钱，他就还得在外面晃荡一夜，回去他得让平叔收拾成腊肉。
心情不大明媚。
沿着街走了一段，项西拐了个弯，这片他不是太熟，来得少，再往前就不是平叔的地盘了，上这片容易惹麻烦。
不过今天得冒点儿险，这边居民区都旧，很多没物业，有的连围墙都没有，进出方便。
在几栋老旧的居民楼之前转了两圈，都是破电瓶车，没意思。
最后项西在一排杂物间前停下了。
馒头没说话，过去挨着几个门看了看，在其中一扇门前站住，从兜里掏了把钳子出来，两下就把杂物间门上的挂锁给弄开了。
“嘿。”馒头一推开门就挺愉快地低声喊了一嗓子。
里面有辆崭新的电瓶车，不过锁得结实，只能卸电瓶。
项西往两边看了看，又抬头往身后的楼上瞅了瞅，都关门闭户的，看着窗口洒出来的灯光，项西有种说不上来的失落感。
真矫情。
馒头卸电瓶的技术不如项西，不过项西今天手有伤，还是因为他伤的，他就得担起这活儿来。
就着远处比蜡烛亮不了多少的路灯，项西看着馒头在杂物房门口忽隐忽现的屁股，他动作也忒不利索了，屁股都进退好几个回合了，还没弄完。
又等了十来秒，项西待不住了，准备过去换馒头出来。
现在是饭点，北风又刮得跟死了爹似的那么凄惨，一般来说不会有人出来，但项西不想冒险，他没吃饭，身上冻透了，总觉得万一让人追到，他会边跑边碎一地渣子。
刚往前走了两步，斜后方楼道里传来了脚步声，听着还挺急，不像正常出门的节奏。
“走！”项西没顾得上多想，过去往里一抓，扯着馒头的衣领就往面街那边跑。
“抓贼！”一个男人的声音在身后响起，这一声暴喝中气十足，“抓贼啊！”
项西不用回头，光凭声音就知道，这人肯定敦实，就自己这样的，扑上去十个也不够人抡一胳膊的。

“追！看打不死他！”另一个声音吼了一声，“昨儿没抓着，今天还敢来！”
项西踉跄了一下，居然有俩！
“分开？”馒头狂奔中问了一句。
“等会儿。”项西说着，扭头看了一眼，那俩人手上都拿着家伙。
这不是临时碰上的，这是人家在楼上就看见了，拿着东西追下来的。
听这意思，这破地儿昨天就已经有人扫过一次了。
点儿真背啊！
项西听着身后的馒头一轻一重的脚步声叹了口气。
这几栋楼地势比较高，一楼下面是个大平台，要下几级楼梯才能到平地上。
俩人转过楼侧之后，项西猛地慢了下来，回手把馒头往平台下面推了一把，压低声音说：“你一会儿再走。”
馒头跟个麻袋似的被他一把推了下去。
项西扫了一眼，台子不高，但要是蹲着，也能躲过去，他拔腿继续往前跑。
虽然打架和挨揍都不是项西的长项，但跑步是，身后的追兵挺执着地一直追到了外面的街上，终于放弃了。
项西找了个背风的墙角，靠着墙喘了半天，这下也不冷了，身上都出毛毛汗了，就是嗓子眼儿又干又涩的。
“东西都没拿着也追得这么狠！”馒头跟他在街口碰了头，“你没事吧？”
“没事，”项西看了他一眼，估计是被推下去的时候蹭到了地面，馒头脸上一大片灰，他把手揣进兜里，“走吧。”
“上哪儿？”馒头往地上啐了一口，掏了烟盒出来，瞅了瞅，已经空了，他有些不爽地把空烟盒捏扁了一扔：“有烟吗？”
“没，”项西埋头往前走，“吃点儿东西去。”
“吃东西？不再弄一个吗？今儿回吗？”馒头拍了拍裤腿上的灰，“就这么回去咱俩估计没好日子过，今儿出来的时候我看平叔那脸拉的……哎，我说小展，你最近怎么这么不起劲，以前也不这样，两天都没开张不像你风格……话都没了。”
“抽烟吗？”项西从兜里掏出烟盒递到馒头跟前。

“嘿！”馒头拿了两根出来，一根别到耳朵上，一根点了，“你不说没烟吗？”

content_en:
This looks more miserable. Mantou said that if he is caught, the offender may just be soft-hearted and let it go.
"I don't even know." Xiang Xi didn't want to talk too much. First, he opened his mouth to talk nonsense. Second, he didn't get any money for two days. If he still didn't get any money tonight, he would have to hang out all night. When he got back, he would have Uncle Ping pack it into bacon.
The mood is not very bright.
After walking along the street for a while, Xiang west turned a corner. He was not too familiar with this area and had been there rarely. If he went further, it would no longer be Uncle Ping's territory. It would be easy to get into trouble here.
But today I have to take a risk. The residential areas here are all old, many have no properties, and some don't even have walls, making it easy to enter and exit.
I drove around twice in front of several old residential buildings. They were all broken-down battery cars, which was boring.
Finally, Xiang west stopped in front of a row of utility rooms.
Steamed Bun didn't say anything. He went over to look at several doors, stopped in front of one of them, took out a pair of pliers from his pocket, and opened the padlock on the utility room door with two clicks.
"Hey." Steamed Bun shouted happily in a low voice as soon as he opened the door.
There is a brand new battery car inside, but the lock is strong and the battery can only be removed.
Xiang west looked to both sides, then raised his head to look upstairs behind him. All the doors were closed. Looking at the light spilling out of the window, Xiang west felt an indescribable sense of loss.
How pretentious.
Steamed Bun's skills in unloading batteries are not as good as Xiang Xi's, but Xiang west's hand was injured today, and it was because of his injury that he had to take on this job.
Looking at the street lamp in the distance, which was not much brighter than a candle, Xiang Xi looked at Steamed Bun's butt that flickered in and out of sight at the door of the utility room. His movements were too awkward, and his butt had moved forward and back for several rounds, but he hadn't finished yet.
After waiting for another ten seconds, Xiang west couldn't wait any longer and was ready to go over and bring out steamed buns.
It was meal time, and the north wind was blowing as miserable as his dead father. Generally speaking, no one would come out, but Xiang Xi didn't want to take risks. He hadn't eaten, and he was completely frozen. He always felt that if someone caught him, he would be smashed into pieces as he ran.
Just after taking two steps forward, footsteps came from the corridor diagonally behind me. It sounded quite urgent, not like a normal rhythm of going out.
"Let's go!" Xiang west didn't think too much, went over to grab it, grabbed the steamed bun by the collar, and ran towards the street.
"Catch the thief!" A man's voice sounded from behind, and this shout was full of anger, "Catch the thief!"
Xiang west didn't need to look back. He knew just by his voice that this man must be solid. With his condition, even ten people wouldn't be able to shake his arm if he jumped at him.
"Chase! See if you can't kill him!" Another voice roared, "I didn't catch him yesterday, but you still dare to come today!"
Xiang west staggered, there were two of them!
"Separate?" Steamed Bun asked while running wildly.
"Wait a minute." Xiang west said, turning his head and taking a look. Both of them had dicks in their hands.
This was not a temporary encounter. Someone saw it from upstairs and chased it down with something.
From what I heard, this poor place had already been swept by someone yesterday.
What a shame!
Xiang west sighed as he listened to the light and heavy footsteps of the steamed bun behind him.
These buildings are on relatively high ground. There is a large platform below the first floor. You have to go down several stairs to reach the level ground.
After the two of them turned around the side of the building, Xiang west suddenly slowed down, reached back and pushed the steamed bun under the platform, and said in a low voice: "You can leave later."
He pushed the bun down like a sack.
Xiang west glanced at it and saw that the platform was not high, but he could avoid it if he squatted down. He took off and continued running forward.
Although fighting and being beaten were not Xiang Xi's strengths, running was. The pursuers behind him persisted and chased him to the street outside before finally giving up.
Xiang west found a corner with no wind and leaned against the wall to catch his breath for a long time. He was no longer cold now, his body was covered in sweat, but his throat was dry and astringent.
"You chased him so fiercely even though you didn't even have anything in your hands!" Steamed Bun met him at the street intersection."Are you okay?"
"It's okay," Xiang west glanced at him. He probably touched the ground when he was pushed down. There was a large amount of dust on the bun's face. He put his hands in his pockets, "Let's go."
"Where?" Steamed Bun spat on the ground, took out the cigarette case and took a look. It was empty. He flattened the empty cigarette case and threw it away with some displeasure: "Do you have any cigarettes?"
"No," Xiang west buried his head and walked forward, "Let's go have something to eat."
"Eat something? Don't you want to get another one? Are you going back today?" Steamed Bun patted the dust on his trouser legs, "We probably won't have a good time if we go back like this. When I came out today, I saw Uncle Ping's face... Hey, let me tell you, Xiao Zhan, why have you been so unmotivated recently? You haven't been like this before. It's not like you to not open for two days... I have lost my words."
"Do you want to smoke?" Xiang west took out the cigarette case from his pocket and handed it to the steamed bun.
"Hey!" He took out two steamed buns, pinned one to his ear, and lit one, "Didn't you say you didn't have any cigarettes?"
